Name: Grandma
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content patcher mod that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47339]Text Replace[/url] to replace all references to Grandpa with Grandma. 

It also includes custom graphics for:

[list]
[*]The intro bed scene, giving Grandma a proper bed (and replacing the picture on the mantle with one of Grandpa)[/*]
[*]The evaluation ghost portrait and ghost sprite[/*]
[/list]Graphics made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Hxoni/mods]Hxoñi [/url]on commission.


Text changes are mostly just the word "Grandpa" => "Grandma", but there are a few others as well:

[list]
[*]replacements of "his" and "him" with "her" when referring to Grandpa[/*]
[*]replacements of "my boy" with "my dear"[/*]
[*]replacements of "my dear boy" with "my dearest grand-son"[/*]
[*]replacements of "grandfather" with "grandmother"[/*]
[*]replacement of "old boy" with "old coot" and "would ya" with "would you" in grandpa's letter[/*]
[/list]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47339]Text Replace[/url].
